canonical_project: TechPark CV Mindelo campus data centre + phase-2 DR site
notes: Barlavento / São Vicente / Mindelo. Second TechPark campus inaugurated 2025-05-06; AfDB release states the Mindelo facility includes a data centre, incubation hub and training centre. Phase 2 (€14M/≈US$15.3M, signed 2023-08-01) adds two data centers and a disaster-recovery site on the São Vicente campus, renewable-energy powered; AfDB TOR (2026-04-28) confirms Phase II in implementation (status construction/under development for the phase-2 DC/DR scope). Bantumen notes Cabo Verde now has three data centers and five digital-economy buildings across both campuses. Capacity null. Other Barlavento islands (Santo Antão, São Nicolau, Sal, Boa Vista) and uninhabited Santa Luzia: no public DC projects found in this sweep.
